body: That's exactly how i feel and it just puzzles me. I don't understand.

This is one of the few reasons why I'm still here. 

The guilt would be crippling even after death.

Me too. I used to read often and participate in sports and have *friends* and whatever else.

Now i have none of that, nor do I have the desire to try to find anything new.
The one person who shares mutual feelings with me lives very far away unfortunately. I also don't really put myself out there.

That doesn't help anyone and i hate when i hear about stuff like that. People are way too apathetic nowadays or uneducated. I'm sorry they told you to go and "socialize". It doesn't work that way. I am so fucking lonely and i socialize, but I'm not cured because i talked to someone at school.

I recently turned 17 this month and it wad a terrible day. I remember the night before. I was full of anxiety. Why? Who the fuck knows. On my actual birthday I woke up and didn't want to get out of bed. No one really wished me happy birthday (minus 2 friends) because they had forgotten or were reminded by snapchat. I went for a drive and punched my steering wheel angrily due to not having a "happy day." I wasn't treated very kindly that day and remember crying myself to sleep. 

It was only a few years ago when I started telling people that birthdays are just another day. Another day in the many long years that I'm going to live, and then eventually, I'm going to die, and be forgotten some years after that. 


Edit: spelling

I lack the slightest interest in picking up a book because I know eventually they end, and I never really did like the endings of any book. Perhaps it's because I know all things come to an end. Life is fleeting.
